description.zh: 自动响应规则ID列表，json数组。
description.en: A JSON array of automated response rule IDs.

description.zh:
规则开启状态。 取值：
- true：开启
- false：关闭
description.en:
The enabling status of the rule. Valid values:

- true: enabled

- false: disabled

description.zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
description.en:
The region where the Data Management center for threat analysis is deployed. You must select a region based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in a region outside China.

description.zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID。
description.en: The ID of the member account that the administrator wants to access.

description.zh:
视图类型。

- 0：当前阿里云账号视图。
- 1：企业下所有账号的视图。
description.en:
The view type.

- 0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: The view of all accounts that belong to the enterprise.

title.zh: 更新自动化响应规则状态

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloud-siem update-automate-response-config-status --ids 123,345 --in-use true --role-type 1 --role-for 1130916744880000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
